text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Sprinters Stakes
has finally arrived!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho!
Feast your eyes on this, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
My poster is proudly on display
on that signboard over there!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Still, isn't it a bit crooked?
Maybe I should go straighten it out.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"Hey! Is it true that King Halo
has arrived at the venue!?"

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Ah! There they are, right over there!
Hurry, get it on camera!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Oh, you found me.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that's true.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It can be troublesome, but no matter how crowded the street is,
King's first-class aura simply overflows with radiant brilliance.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's go!
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Bystander Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Huh, wait. Is that King?
Haaah~ I knew it, celebrity drama is always something else~.

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Haha, sounds good!
Hype up this race for us too!
King!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Yes, leave it all to me!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, rushing over to the waiting room—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And here it is!
The battle to decide the autumn sprint champion!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Is this the Umamusume drawing the most attention?
The queen—no, the King—who conquered the spring blitzkrieg!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! That's right!
The one who commands everyone's gaze is none other than myself!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I am the first-rate Umamusume, King Halo!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Yes! It's only natural that I win!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Since we're here, let's bask in everyone's cheers, smile,
and fully enjoy this fun time together, okay?
